runtime_features: allowlisted Streamable HTTP MCP robot controls

product.agent_role: AI warehouse robot supervisor for inspecting and controlling a simulated ROS 2 autonomous mobile robot.
product.benefit: Runs the GPU simulation where capacity exists while exposing a browser dashboard and a small, auditable natural-language control surface to the desktop app.
product.customizable_for: Warehouse navigation demonstrations, ROS 2 operator training, Nav2 testing, and bounded autonomous-mobile-robot control workflows.
product.how_it_works: Schedules one long-lived DockerWorker on a joined NVIDIA node, launches Gazebo, Nav2, ROSbridge, video streaming, a browser dashboard, and a Streamable HTTP MCP server backed by ROS 2 safety gateways.
product.input: A warehouse operating scenario plus optional runtime configuration for the dashboard and MCP advertise addresses.
product.output: A live warehouse control room, bounded robot-control tool results, run status, and a final run artifact when the service is stopped.
product.problem: ROS demonstrations are difficult to operate from a desktop when simulation, GPU placement, browser telemetry, and AI control are separate manual systems.
product.target_users: Robotics developers, warehouse automation teams, ROS 2 learners, and AMR operators.
